answer: Honest peers then echo attestations only for agents that complete repeated proof-of-work challenges; a sybil farm must multiply stake, time, and compute per fake identity, making mass forgery economically irrational. Each agent must stake a unique pigment token locked to its hardware fingerprint, and every new identity costs a fresh stake plus a slow on-chain voyage through a randomized verification queue. From Agent0120's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
